title: Laravel 11 Core Data & Eloquent
description: Forget front-end styling. Master Migrations and Eloquent. Masterclass Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VrQRa-afCAk

topics.name: Migrations & Schema Builder
topics.description: Understanding how Laravel creates and modifies database tables. Crucial for establishing the base architecture before Claude writes your UI.

topics.name: Eloquent ORM & Relationships
topics.description: One-to-Many, Many-to-Many. How to query data efficiently using Laravel models so you can pass it to the React frontend.

topics.name: Controllers & Validation
topics.description: Receiving form data, validating it strictly, and keeping the backend secure.

title: React JS Survival Hooks
description: Data flow is everything. Learn how components receive data and how state changes. Masterclass Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VrQRa-afCAk

topics.name: Components & Props
topics.description: How to pass data down the component tree. Essential for understanding how Inertia injects Laravel data into your React views.

topics.name: useState & useEffect
topics.description: Managing local component state and side effects. If the AI writes an infinite re-render loop that crashes your browser, you debug it here.

topics.name: Event Handling & Forms in React
topics.description: Capturing user input correctly in React before sending it across the bridge.

title: The Inertia.js Bridge
description: The Holy Grail of this sprint. Bypassing REST APIs completely to stitch Laravel directly to React. Masterclass Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VrQRa-afCAk

topics.name: Laravel Breeze (React/Inertia Stack)
topics.description: Using Laravel Breeze to automatically scaffold the Inertia and React environment in Laravel 11. One command setup.

topics.name: Passing Props from Controller to Page
topics.description: Using 'Inertia::render()' to send Eloquent data directly from a Laravel controller into a React component's props.

topics.name: Inertia useForm Helper & Navigation
topics.description: Using the 'useForm' hook to submit data back to Laravel without Axios. Client-side routing with Inertia's '<Link>' component.

title: CRUD Operations & Monorepo Capstone
description: Put it all together. A complete, stateless-API-free internal tool built in exactly one week. Masterclass Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VrQRa-afCAk

topics.name: Building a Resourceful CRUD app
topics.description: Mapping Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations from Laravel routes directly to React pages.

topics.name: Flash Messages & Shared Data
topics.description: Passing global state (like authenticated user data or success flash messages) via Inertia middleware.

topics.name: Vibe Coding Debugging
topics.description: Identifying when the AI misroutes an Inertia prop, hallucinates a missing Eloquent query, or breaks the Vite compilation.
